🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY and HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND show muted fear and stable credit, while SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND and TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND highlight the mixed stock/bond tone.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit steady: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND imply limited stress. Volatility muted but uneven: VXX (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY; bonds preferred: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-mildly accommodative: SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND vs TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND suggests modest demand for duration while dollar/yields read as neutral in the barometer.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Healthcare and Biotech leading: XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND; Tech showing weakness: XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given split between XLK and XLF.

5. US vs Global?
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND while IWM (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +2.62%) ABOVE TREND; EM/China lag materially—EEM (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.21%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Selective speculation: ARKK (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY and XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND show pockets of risk-seeking, while IBIT (1W: -6.36% | 1M: -17.76%) BELOW TREND signals crypto pullback.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Commodity weakness: CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -10.71%) BELOW TREND; broad metals and energy underperform.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy soft: XLE (1W: -0.89% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND; UNG (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND shows gas weakness as well.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND and HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCES present across SOXX (1W: -6.21% | 1M: +7.93%) CORRECTION and MTUM (1W: -2.67% | 1M: +6.90%) CORRECTION — treat as minor rotation signals, not a regime flip.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor duration and selective defensive/health exposure given TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to commodity-linked and China ETFs such as FXI (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -0.89% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: none obvious on current data. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -10.71%) BELOW TREND, SLV (1W: -10.58% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND, CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (vol complacency pivot), HYG/LQD ~1.0 (credit-health trigger), XLK/ XLF spread moves of 3-5% as rotation signal, TLT 110-115 (duration demand pivot).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, with mixed signals across volatility, credit and equities. Healthcare and biotech (XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND) showing strength while tech (XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND) and China (FXI (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND) are key weakness; watch SOXX (1W: -6.21% | 1M: +7.93%) CORRECTION divergence as the main momentum risk.
